def cohens_d(a, b):
    pooled_sd = np.sqrt(((len(a) - 1) * a.std(ddof=1) ** 2 +
                         (len(b) - 1) * b.std(ddof=1) ** 2) / (len(a) + len(b) - 2))
    return (a.mean() - b.mean()) / pooled_sd

d = cohens_d(time_A, time_B)
print(f"Cohen's d = {d:.2f}")
print(f"Design B saves about {time_A.mean() - time_B.mean():.1f} s per checkout on average.")

steps.description: cohens_d weights each sample variance by its degrees of freedom. You take the square root after dividing by the combined degrees of freedom to obtain pooled_sd.
